name: oh-my-pi
summary: pi 的开源分支（omp）：查看会话、状态和完整对话；在 tmux（Mac、Linux）、终端窗口（Windows）中运行，或由 Kiteline 在后台运行时，可回复、回答提问和中断
summaryEn: Open-source fork of pi (omp): view sessions, status and full conversations; reply, answer questions and interrupt when it runs in tmux (Mac, Linux), a terminal window (Windows) or in the background through Kiteline

cli.note: 回复、回答和中断需要 omp 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）
回复、回答和中断需要 omp 在 tmux 中运行，或在 Kiteline 新建任务时选它（后台运行）
在终端窗口中运行即可回复、回答和中断

limitsNote: oh-my-pi 不在本机记录订阅额度，「今日用量」中不显示；token 和花费按它自己的记录统计（含输入预测、起标题等辅助调用）
limitsNoteEn: oh-my-pi doesn't record plan quotas on your computer, so they aren't shown under Today's usage; tokens and cost come from its own records (including helper calls such as input prediction and titles)
speaker: oh-my-pi
notes: 新接入 oh-my-pi：查看会话和完整对话，在 tmux 中运行或由 Kiteline 在后台运行时可以从手机回复、回答提问和中断。
notesEn: New: oh-my-pi support. View sessions and full conversations; reply, answer questions and interrupt from your phone when it runs in tmux or in the background through Kiteline.

gaps.text: 提问只能从选项中选：自己填写答案、多选、一次多个问题的提问请在电脑上回答
gaps.textEn: Questions can only be answered by picking an option: answer free-text, multi-select or multi-question prompts on your computer

gaps.text: 从手机发的图片以文件路径随消息发送，由 oh-my-pi 用读文件工具查看：它的终端界面只能从剪贴板贴图
gaps.textEn: Images sent from your phone go with the message as file paths for oh-my-pi to open with its read tool: its terminal interface only accepts images pasted from the clipboard

gaps.text: 在 config.yml 中改了会话目录的，暂时找不到会话：只认默认目录和 --profile 的目录
gaps.textEn: Sessions stored in a custom directory set in config.yml aren't found yet: only the default and --profile directories are read

gaps.text: 第一次运行时的设置向导（登录、选模型）需要在电脑上完成
gaps.textEn: The first-run setup (sign-in, choosing a model) has to be completed on your computer

gaps.text: 没有用真实的模型服务账号实测（用自定义模型配置接测试服务测的）
gaps.textEn: Not tested with a real model provider account (tested through a custom model setting)
